clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos dying in July 1989, within the following months: your mother lying awake over money in March 1988 and stopping talk with your father about it by May 1988, your brother's grades falling by November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in money worry and distance between your parents sit before the death; your brother's functioning falls after it. Your mother's anxiety lifts as she returns to work, and the period settles there.

clusters.name: Your mother Della's breast cancer diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother being told she had breast cancer in February 1995, within the years after you left for college in September 1993: you kept migraines in bed from March 1994, called your brother most nights from April 1994, then stopped returning his calls by June 1995 and stopped calling home by February 1996. Your symptom rose and your moves toward your brother turned to moves away from both him and your mother over these months, and the pattern settles with your distance from home.
